body:
> Blog · Summit Az · 2026-06-18

# Summary
Repair-vs-replace decision post for water heaters, localized from Utah to the East Valley (hard water shortens tank life). Published 2026-06-18 at `/blog/signs-you-need-a-new-water-heater/` (ID 5785).

# Key facts
- Focus keyphrase: signs you need a new water heater. SEO title (54 chars): "Signs You Need a New Water Heater (Not Just Repair)".
- Links: water heater services Chandler (money page), sibling hard-water post, water softener installation Chandler, contact.
- External source: Energy.gov tankless/storage water heater life expectancy page.
- Quick answer lists age past 10 to 15 years, rusty water, sediment noise, pooling at the base and repeated repairs (age range attributed to the energy.gov source in the file).
- Internal URLs were supplied by Kim and not re-crawled when drafted; file says confirm before publishing.

# Utah flag
- Utah original at `blogs\_utah_originals\signs-you-need-a-new-water-heater.md`. The AZ file notes the old summitplumbingut.com domain was fully replaced with summitplumbingpros.com URLs.
